about: Reviewed clauses for cards the parser cannot read (spec §8.1). Each entry was written by reading reviewedText, the synced card text it applies to.
An entry whose reviewedText differs from the current synced text is ignored and reported stale by the coverage report: re-read the card and update the entry.
Vocabulary: src/engine/text/vocab.ts (TRIGGERS, EFFECT_KINDS, TARGETS); kind "special" marks an effect the text does not spell out.

Aurora.reviewedText: On Reveal: Give one of your other On Reveal cards at each location +2 Power. Repeat for Ongoing, Activate, and End of Turn.
Aurora.note: Second sentence repeats the first for three more keywords (mechanics §5: elliptical).

ArthurPendragon.reviewedText: On Reveal: Pull Excalibur free to here.
ArthurPendragon.note: Task 12 calibration: the card's value is the Excalibur it brings, whose synced token row reads "Ongoing: Your 4-Cost or more cards have +2 Power." (Card.tokens = ["Excalibur"]). The parser reads only the summon, so Arthur had no link to the 4-Cost cards it is played with and 'Make it stronger' cut it from Arthur lists. The second clause carries Excalibur's text; it applies while Excalibur is in play.

clauses.text: Pull Excalibur free to here.
Your 4-Cost or more cards have +2 Power.
notes: Excalibur's text (token row), not Arthur's own
